title: FR-1 dm/ conventions + atomic write (dm_store module)
summary: Created src-tauri/src/commands/dm_store.rs (registered in commands/mod.rs): kind-to-path mapping (pages/<slug>.json, master-items/{measure,dimension}/<id>.json, relationships.json, saved-queries/<slug>.sql, connections.json, drafts/), valid_name guard (rejects traversal/leading dots/leading-trailing whitespace, allows interior spaces), atomic_write (temp+rename, temp cleanup on failure), check_json_object parse-level shape check, and path-to-name inverses. 11 tests green; first run caught 2 real bugs (.sql stem fall-through, whitespace contradiction). Known ceiling: crash-between-write-and-rename not unit-testable without fault injection; documented in module doc.

title: FR-2 Pages file store (commands remap)
summary: pages.rs rewritten file-backed: dm/pages/<slug>.json via dm_store, commands take AppHandle + ws_dir() (no DuckDbState), *_in(ws,...) cores for testability. save writes spec verbatim (invalid JSON included - file mirrors editor, watcher classifies); get_page extracts title best-effort + mtime as updatedAt; list_pages skips invalid files into errors[] array, sorts mtime desc, missing dir = empty; delete idempotent; slug guard rejects traversal. Invoke names/params unchanged (central-api.ts untouched, title param accepted-but-vestigial). 8 tests green, full suite 83/83.

title: FR-3 Master items + relationships file store
summary: items.rs file-backed: dm/master-items/{measures,dimensions}/<id>.json (filename=id, folder=kind, no timestamps), get searches both folders, list filters/sorts deterministic + errors[] for invalid files, delete idempotent, save guards kind+id. relationships.rs: single dm/relationships.json doc, upsert-by-id (generated rel-<from>-<to> slug fallback), delete idempotent, and a clobber guard - corrupt existing doc makes list error loudly AND save refuse (never overwrite a hand-edited broken graph). dm_store item folders corrected to plural (measures/dimensions) per spec tree. 13 new tests; full suite 92/92.

title: FR-4 Saved queries file store
summary: saved_queries.rs rewritten file-backed: dm/saved-queries/<slug>.sql, slug=generate_slug(name) (same-name overwrite kept). Optional single-line '-- dm: {json}' header (name/description/tags) - app always writes it, headerless agent files default name=stem; malformed header = reported error (list errors[] + update refuses), never silently treated as SQL. tags = JSON array in file, comma-separated string at invoke boundary (frontend splits on ','). update = partial merge keeping unspecified fields, slug/filename unchanged on rename. No timestamps in files. 7 tests; full suite 95/95.

title: FR-5 Connections store + /connect saved-connections UI
summary: New commands/connections.rs: dm/connections.json = {connections:[{name, urlEnv}]} - NON-secret metadata only; the connection-string URL (contains password) lives in the workspace .env as DM_CONN_<SLUG>_URL (gitignored). ws_env_set appends/replaces the var preserving all other lines via atomic_write; ws_env_value resolves workspace .env then process env; resolve_connection returns the URL or an error naming the var + .env path. Clobber guard (corrupt doc refuses save). /connect database tab gains saved-connections select (Connect/Delete) + save-current-with-name row; $effect loads on tab activation. Invoke names new: list/save/delete/resolve_connection. 7 Rust tests + svelte-check 0 errors; full suite 102/102.

title: FR-6 Migration + workspace git bootstrap
summary: New commands/migration.rs hooked into initialize_duckdb (after initialize_schema): migrate_content_tables exports the four d8a_monster_* content tables to dm/ files by REUSING the store functions (format consistency by construction; write_query_file added to saved_queries for exact-slug writes), write-ALL-then-verify-then-drop ordering, files-win skip-if-exists, idempotent no-op when tables absent, empty relationships graph still materializes its doc (test caught the edge). bootstrap_gitignore writes .env/*.duckdb/*.duckdb.wal when missing, never overwrites. Secret policy in settings.rs: save_settings moves llmApiKey to workspace .env (LLM_API_KEY) and strips it from settings.json when a workspace is open; get_settings env overrides now check workspace .env first. Migration failure = warning (tables intact, next launch retries). 8 new tests; full suite 110/110.

title: FR-7 File watcher (notify + debounce + echo suppression + events)
summary: New commands/dm_watch.rs + notify = 8 dep. Pipeline: notify events on dm/ recursive -> mpsc -> debounced flusher thread (300ms window, removals win over modifies) -> echo check -> classify(ws, path, removed) PURE fn -> emit dm:changed {kind,name,removed} / dm:error {path,reason}. Echo suppression: registry keyed by destination path fed by dm_store::atomic_write (mark after successful rename), 600ms window >= write debounce 400ms. classify handles pages/master-items/relationships/saved-queries/connections with parse-level checks; drafts, docs, README, .env, settings, unknown files ignored (agent scratch safe). Watcher starts on initialize_duckdb, replaced on workspace switch (drop = stop). 5 classification/echo tests; full suite 115/115.

title: FR-8 Frontend live-reload (dm:changed / dm:error handling)
summary: New src/lib/dm-events.ts: onDmChanged(kind, cb) registry + onDmError + pure routeDmEvent routing core (malformed payloads ignored) + initDmEvents() wired once in +layout.svelte (errors -> console.warn + app.globalError banner). Views subscribe in $effect with off() cleanup: /pages list (page), /pages/[slug] editor (page -> reloadDoc when slug matches; measure/dimension/relationships -> refreshItems), /query (saved-query -> loadSavedQueries), ItemEditor (its kind), RelationshipEditor (relationships), /connect (connections -> loadSavedConnections). tests/dm-events.test.ts: routing matrix + registry off() semantics. vitest 125/125; svelte-check 0 errors.
